declaring_sources.evidence_class: schemas/evidence-node.schema.json and schemas/experiment-result.schema.json (evidence_class enums; the empirical subset is derived from the enum markers rather than a hand-kept list, so a schema that names a new empirical or observational class moves the boundary with it)
declaring_sources.reconciliation: schemas/evidence-reconciliation-record.schema.json (record field set, target_evidence_role and promotion_decision enums, record_hash pattern) reconciled over the V03 execution record and V02 preregistration surfaces

failed_run_not_confirmation.mechanism: a result may be entered under the confirming support role only when V03's execution gate was PASS, the experiment-result status was COMPLETED and the preregistered falsification outcome was NOT_FALSIFIED; a run that failed, incidented or never started, a non-completed status, or a falsified or inconclusive outcome makes the support role a REJECT (CONFIRMATION_WITHOUT_CLEAN_RUN) rather than a quiet downgrade, and promotion always requires that positive conjunction, never merely the absence of a refusal, so a broken pipeline can never read as confirmation

simulation_formal_benchmark_empirical_re.mechanism: reconciliation copies the source evidence class forward verbatim into source_evidence_class and never launders it; the one policed transformation is EF4-I11 — a source whose class is not empirical may not be entered as an empirical candidate — and the empirical subset is read from the evidence-node and experiment-result enum markers at runtime (asserted non-empty and proper), so a relabel across that boundary is REJECT (EVIDENCE_CLASS_OVERCLAIMED) with non_empirical_guard_passed=false while simulation, formal and benchmark stay distinct from observation

independent_review.evidence: review.md (author: bounded implementation agent; reviewer: an independent reviewer distinct from the author; actor independence between author and reviewer holds, external certification does not)
